findings.current: “Do you still not know what kind of man he is? Even if hundreds of thousands or tens of millions died, Michael Silbert would not bat an eye.”
findings.defect: The draft changes 수백, meaning hundreds, into hundreds of thousands, materially altering the stated casualty range.
findings.rationale: The source explicitly contrasts hundreds with tens of millions; it does not mention hundreds of thousands.
findings.replacement: “Do you still not know what kind of man he is? Even if hundreds died—or tens of millions—Michael Silbert would not bat an eye.”
findings.source: 설령 수백, 수천만이 죽는다고 해도 미카엘 실베르트는 눈 하나 깜짝하지 않을 겁니다.

findings.current: That was why he had built the entire stage from beginning to end, eliminating any possibility of aid from other countries and creating a situation in which the Skeleton King had no choice but to reveal himself.
findings.defect: The draft turns 나서다, meaning to step in or take action, into the more explicit “reveal himself,” replacing Michael’s immediate mechanical objective with its eventual consequence.
findings.rationale: The source says Michael engineered circumstances that forced the Skeleton King to act; it does not directly state that the compelled action was self-revelation.
findings.replacement: That was why he had built the entire stage from beginning to end, eliminating any possibility of aid from other countries and creating a situation in which the Skeleton King had no choice but to step in.
findings.source: 타국의 지원군이 끼어들 여지를 제거하여 스켈레톤 킹이 나설 수밖에 없는 환경을 조성했다.

findings.current: After muttering nonstop about his son and the beach, as well as a certain third hole he normally kept hidden from other people, Magic Johnson rubbed his smooth crown, not a single hair growing on it.
findings.defect: Adding “his” literalizes the deliberately oblique “son and beach” profanity joke as a reference to Johnson’s actual child and a location.
findings.rationale: 아들과 해변 is a euphemistic decomposition of an English curse, not a statement about Johnson’s family or travel plans; the source preserves the joke indirectly.
findings.replacement: After muttering nonstop about a son and a beach, as well as a certain third hole he normally kept hidden from other people, Magic Johnson rubbed his perfectly smooth, hairless crown.
findings.source: 아들과 해변이라든지, 평소에는 다른 사람이 볼 수 없게 숨겨 둔 제3의 구멍에 대해서도 쉴 새 없이 중얼거리던 매직 존슨은 모근 하나 없이 매끈한 정수리를 문질렀다.

findings.current: *If the strength that Japanese netizens and Japanophiles raved about was really so impressive, why had he arrived only after Leviathan was dead, despite having an entire day to get there?*
findings.defect: “Japanophiles raved about” sanitizes both the derogatory 일뽕 and the crude praise implied by 빨아 재끼다, weakening Jin’s contemptuous register.
findings.rationale: The source uses deliberately disparaging internet slang and a vulgar expression for excessive praise; Jin’s narration should retain that hostility rather than neutralize it.
findings.replacement: *If he was really as strong as all those Japanese netizens and Japan-worshipping fanboys dickriding him claimed, why had he shown up so late that Leviathan was already dead when he’d had an entire day to get there?*
findings.source: 일본 네티즌과 일뽕들이 열심히 빨아 재끼는 그 실력이 사실이라면, 왜 하루라는 시간이 있었음에도 레비아탄이 쓰러진 후에야 느지막이 도착했겠나.

findings.current: Even setting aside the fact that Korean Hunters are far stronger, our government has been on high alert ever since Seok Go Jun artificially caused two Monster Waves.
findings.defect: The established character name 석고준 is Go Jun; “Seok Go Jun” incorrectly treats the title-derived Seok as part of his personal name.
findings.rationale: The binding glossary explicitly maps both 고준 and the source full-name form 석고준 to Go Jun.
findings.replacement: Even setting aside the fact that Korean Hunters are far stronger, our government has been on high alert ever since Go Jun artificially caused two Monster Waves.
findings.source: 우리 정부는 석고준이 인위적으로 벌인 두 번의 몬스터 웨이브 이후부터는 언제나 촉각을 곤두세우고 있었습니다.

summary: One critical quantity error, two meaningful action/register shifts, and two terminology or euphemism defects require correction.
